name: TimePlast TimeMass Fire
filament_notes: TimeMass Fire Gen 2. Dry 68C/155F at least 2 h before every print. Use the external spool, not AMS. Print with the printer door open. Official nozzle is 0.8 mm. Vendor CryoGrip plate bed temperature is 75C (not mapped to a Bambu plate key). Assumption: cool, engineering and smooth high-temp plate temperatures are not published by the vendor and keep the Generic PLA template defaults. Safety: Print with ventilation, door open; Never leave a burning print unattended; Combustion byproducts not fully tested by Timeplast; Keep away from children and pets; Not for safety-critical/commercial use without independent verification.
